description: Monthly cost of a described workload, or of measured usage, on each model. Accounts for history compounding, cache writes, long-context tiers and reasoning tokens. Use this instead of multiplying prices by hand.

reasoning_multiplier.description: Bill output at this multiple. Default 1.

usage.description: Measured totals to price instead: input, output, cache_read, cache_write tokens (input excludes cache reads).

name: estimate_cost
